scope: Theorem 1.1 (Area-controlled end replacement) of the manuscript “Area-controlled end replacement and the Bondi Penrose inequality in the CKS class” (preprints/Area-controlled-end-replacement-and-the-Bondi-Penrose-inequality-in-the-CKS-class-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbf670183435f218), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (Ω, g, K) be a smooth connected orientable three-dimensional exterior, complete including its nonempty compact smooth boundary, with exactly one end of class (1.3). Suppose DEC holds and EB > |PB|. There is a balanced chart such that, for every sufficiently large R, smooth data (GR, kR) on the same exterior have the following properties: 1. They agree with (g, K) on the compact side of r = R and satisfy DEC. 2. For numbers 0 ≤ εR < 1 with εR → 0, GR ≥ (1 − εR)g everywhere on Ω. 3. The end is asymptotically flat, with GR − δ = Oj(r−1) for every fixed finite j, and kR = 0 sufficiently far out. The constraints are integrable and its charges satisfy PR = 0, ER = mB+ηR, where 0 ≤ ηR ≤ 2R−1/2. The new exterior is complete and Amin,GR (S) ≥ (1 − εR)Amin,g(S). No condition on the boundary expansion is needed.
